info.title: Infrastructure Lifecycle Management API
info.description: Outbound agent infrastructure lifecycle API. Campaigns support immutable target snapshots, four staged rollouts, independent approvals, explicit IANA maintenance windows, shared concurrency reservations, bounded retries, topology-aware canary selection, safety pause gates and signed cancellation. UpgradeFleet selects a pinned local executor per target so one staged campaign can span self-managed and provider-managed clusters; provider-native adapters remain optional. UpgradePackages has an opt-in, unqualified Debian Ansible EE operator path; UpgradeNodePool has an opt-in, unqualified GKE native operator path. Cluster-local policy and safety checks remain authoritative. Operators create/start/pause/cancel campaigns; approvers approve/reject and acknowledge safety resumes. Administrators manage org limits and memberships. All organization reads require membership. Bootstrap bearer is restricted to isolated local development. The dashboard API never receives Kubernetes credentials. Audit events are hash chained and protected against application-role updates/deletes/truncation.

bootstrapBearer.description: Generated development-only global admin token; minimum 32 characters.

oidcBearer.description: OIDC ID token from the configured issuer and audience. Subject membership is looked up in PostgreSQL.

providerMetadata.description: Required when provider is gke; records only project and location, never credentials.

LifecycleInventory.description: Advisory Kubernetes metadata only; never grants host or provider execution permission. Host package manager, immutability, disk, repository and driver qualification are not established by this record.

providerId.description: Provider resource identity reported by Kubernetes, used to bind native lifecycle plans to the observed node and failure domain.

labels.description: Complete Kubernetes node labels, at most 4096 total key/value bytes; null from legacy agents cannot satisfy a nonempty campaign selector.

zone.description: Maximum active operations for one topology zone across the organization; unknown target zones conservatively overlap all zones.

canaryTopologyKey.description: Automatically select at least one canary target per observed site, cluster, and topology-label value. Empty uses normal site/cluster interleaving.

present.description: Whether this node appeared in the most recent successful full inventory report.

previousHash.description: Hex SHA-256 hash of the preceding event in this organization; empty for legacy rows.

eventHash.description: Hex SHA-256 of previousHash bytes concatenated with the versioned canonical event JSON; empty for legacy rows.

ProviderMetadata.description: Non-secret GKE identity metadata. GKE registrations require this object.
